knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The procedure says to check power supply, plugs, cords, guards, hoses, wheels, filters, tanks, batteries and accessories, and confirm inspection tags.
A defect that affects safe use means the equipment is removed from service, labelled and reported. The lesson says never to tape a damaged lead and continue.
The core procedure says to confirm inspection tags or site requirements before use.

practicalCriteria: Finds critical faults and demonstrates correct isolation and reporting.
Explains applicable scope and site procedures
Demonstrates hazard controls and safe stop-work decisions
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of procedure step 5: If a defect affects safe use, remove the equipment from service, label it and report it through the approved channel.
stopWorkCriteria: Stop work if procedure step 6 is not done: Never tape over a damaged lead and continue working with it.

Stop work if procedure step 7 is not done: Before acting on any unclear situation, ask what the surface, soil or hazard is and which product or method is approved. If the answer is unclear, pause, protect the area and seek supervisor guidance.
